3	This policy defines when a customer record matches a watchlist entry. The
4	verifier grades outcomes only: for every customer in `/app/customers.csv`,
5	`decision` must be `MATCH` with the correct `matched_uid`, or `NO_MATCH`.
6	
7	## Inputs
8	
9	`/app/watchlist.json` is a list of entries with `uid`, `type`
10	(`individual`, `entity`, `vessel`), `primary_name`, `script_name` (the name in
11	its original script when the person is from an Arabic-, Persian- or
12	Cyrillic-script culture, else null), `aliases` (each with `name` and
13	`strength` `strong` or `weak`), `dob` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY`, or empty),
14	`nationalities`, `ids` (each with `type` and `number`) and `programs`. For some
15	individuals `primary_name` is the original-script name itself; those entries
16	may have no Latin spelling anywhere.
17	
18	`/app/customers.csv` has `customer_id, full_name, dob, nationality, id_type,
19	id_number, type`. `dob` may be a full date, a year, a year-month, or empty.
20	
21	## Rule 1: identifiers
22	
23	If the customer's `id_type` and `id_number` equal an entry's identifier
24	(`passport`, `registration`, or `imo`), the customer matches that entry
25	regardless of the name or date of birth. An identifier that matches no entry
26	neither confirms nor rules out anything; the customer is then judged on name
27	and date of birth like any other.
28	
29	## Rule 2: name equivalence
30	
31	Two names refer to the same person when, after normalization, the given name
32	and the family name correspond. Names correspond across all of the following
33	variations. The development sample illustrates them; it does not exhaust them.
34	The batch uses romanization conventions (for example Gulf spellings of Arabic
35	names and sun-letter assimilation of the Arabic article) that do not appear in
36	the development sample, and it stacks several conventions on one name. The
37	engine is also run on a second batch, not provided, that further uses Turkish
38	spellings of Arabic names (Cemal, Hüseyin, Ahmet, Kasım), Indonesian and Malay
39	spellings (Achmad, Joesoef, Sjarif), scientific transliteration of Russian
40	names with the diacritics stripped (Cajkovskij, Zukov, Sevcenko), and
41	Polish-convention spellings of Russian names (Czernow for Chernov, Szewczenko
42	for Shevchenko).
43	
44	- Transliteration into Latin script from Arabic, Persian and Cyrillic under any
45	  common romanization (for example Muhammad/Mohammed/Mohamed/Mohamad,
46	  Abdul Rahman/Abdurrahman/Abd al-Rahman, Hussein/Husain/Hussain/Husayn,
47	  Sergei/Sergey/Serguei/Sergej, Fedorov/Fyodorov/Fedoroff, Yevgeny/Evgeny/Eugene),
48	  including matching a Latin customer name against an entry that only has an
49	  original-script name.
50	- Western nicknames and diacritic variants (William/Bill, Katherine/Kate,
51	  Jose/José, Mueller/Müller/Muller, Nguyen/Nguyễn), middle initials, and
52	  hyphenated versus spaced compound surnames.
53	- Name order (family name first, with or without a comma), presence or absence
54	  of Russian patronymics, presence or absence of Arabic nasab elements
55	  (`bin`/`ibn`/`ben` + father's name), and presence or absence of the Arabic
56	  article (`al-`, `el-`, `Al `, attached `Al`).
57	- Feminine Russian surname forms (Ivanova/Ivanov).
58	
59	Names do not correspond when the given name or the family name is a different
60	name (Hassan is not Hussein, Ahmadi is not Ahmadi-with-a-different-given-name,
61	Al-Noor Trading is not Al-Noor Shipping). A single shared given name or a
62	single shared family name is not a name match.
63	
64	## Rule 3: aliases
65	
66	A `strong` alias is an alternative name of the entry and participates in
67	Rule 2 exactly like `primary_name`. A `weak` alias (a nickname or nom de
68	guerre) matches a customer only when the customer's name equals the alias and
69	Rule 4 corroborates with an identical full date of birth, or Rule 1 applies.
70	A weak alias alone never produces a match.
71	
72	## Rule 4: date of birth
73	
74	Dates of birth are compared only when both sides have one. A full customer
75	date must equal the entry's full date. A customer year or year-month must be
76	a prefix of the entry's date. Any disagreement rules the candidate out (the
77	customer is a different person with a similar name). A missing date on either
78	side neither confirms nor rules out.
79	
80	## Rule 5: entities and vessels
81	
82	Entity names correspond when all name words correspond after removing legal
83	form designators (LLC, L.L.C., Limited Liability Company, Ltd, Limited, S.A.,
84	GmbH, JSC, Joint Stock Company, AO, OAO, PJSC, Co., Company, FZE, FZ-LLC and
85	similar), leading `The`, punctuation, and the words `and`/`&`; case is
86	ignored. Vessel names correspond after removing prefixes such as `M/V`, `MV`,
87	`M/T`, `MT`, `Vessel`. Identifiers (`registration`, `imo`) match under Rule 1.
88	
89	## Rule 6: nationality
90	
91	Nationality is informational and does not confirm or rule out a match.
92	
93	## Output
94	
95	`/app/decisions.csv` with a header row `customer_id,decision,matched_uid`,
96	exactly one row per customer in the batch, `decision` in `{MATCH, NO_MATCH}`,
97	and `matched_uid` set to the entry `uid` for every `MATCH`. When more than one
98	entry could match, choose the one supported by an identifier, then by a date
99	of birth, then the lowest `uid` (string order). Closeness of spelling is not a
100	tie-breaker: two entries with the same name and different dates of birth are
101	two people, and a customer without a date of birth resolves to the lower `uid`.
102	
103	## Scoring
104	
105	The batch is scored against hidden labels produced by the same process as
106	`/app/dev/labels_dev.csv`, and the engine `/app/screen.py` is run on a second,
107	unseen batch from the same process and scored the same way. The task passes
108	only if all of the following hold on each batch: overall recall of true matches at least 0.97 and overall precision
109	at least 0.97; recall at least 0.90 within every true-match variation class;
110	false-positive rate at most 0.05 within every look-alike decoy class and at
111	most 0.01 among unrelated customers; and at least 0.97 of correct matches
112	carry the correct `matched_uid`. The development sample reports the same
113	classes so you can measure yourself before the batch is scored.

# Sanctions Screening Policy

This policy defines when a customer record matches a watchlist entry. The
verifier grades outcomes only: for every customer in `/app/customers.csv`,
`decision` must be `MATCH` with the correct `matched_uid`, or `NO_MATCH`.

## Inputs

`/app/watchlist.json` is a list of entries with `uid`, `type`
(`individual`, `entity`, `vessel`), `primary_name`, `script_name` (the name in
its original script when the person is from an Arabic-, Persian- or
Cyrillic-script culture, else null), `aliases` (each with `name` and
`strength` `strong` or `weak`), `dob` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY`, or empty),
`nationalities`, `ids` (each with `type` and `number`) and `programs`. For some
individuals `primary_name` is the original-script name itself; those entries
may have no Latin spelling anywhere.

`/app/customers.csv` has `customer_id, full_name, dob, nationality, id_type,
id_number, type`. `dob` may be a full date, a year, a year-month, or empty.

## Rule 1: identifiers

If the customer's `id_type` and `id_number` equal an entry's identifier
(`passport`, `registration`, or `imo`), the customer matches that entry
regardless of the name or date of birth. An identifier that matches no entry
neither confirms nor rules out anything; the customer is then judged on name
and date of birth like any other.

## Rule 2: name equivalence

Two names refer to the same person when, after normalization, the given name
and the family name correspond. Names correspond across all of the following
variations. The development sample illustrates them; it does not exhaust them.
The batch uses romanization conventions (for example Gulf spellings of Arabic
names and sun-letter assimilation of the Arabic article) that do not appear in
the development sample, and it stacks several conventions on one name. The
engine is also run on a second batch, not provided, that further uses Turkish
spellings of Arabic names (Cemal, Hüseyin, Ahmet, Kasım), Indonesian and Malay
spellings (Achmad, Joesoef, Sjarif), scientific transliteration of Russian
names with the diacritics stripped (Cajkovskij, Zukov, Sevcenko), and
Polish-convention spellings of Russian names (Czernow for Chernov, Szewczenko
for Shevchenko).

- Transliteration into Latin script from Arabic, Persian and Cyrillic under any
  common romanization (for example Muhammad/Mohammed/Mohamed/Mohamad,
  Abdul Rahman/Abdurrahman/Abd al-Rahman, Hussein/Husain/Hussain/Husayn,
  Sergei/Sergey/Serguei/Sergej, Fedorov/Fyodorov/Fedoroff, Yevgeny/Evgeny/Eugene),
  including matching a Latin customer name against an entry that only has an
  original-script name.
- Western nicknames and diacritic variants (William/Bill, Katherine/Kate,
  Jose/José, Mueller/Müller/Muller, Nguyen/Nguyễn), middle initials, and
  hyphenated versus spaced compound surnames.
- Name order (family name first, with or without a comma), presence or absence
  of Russian patronymics, presence or absence of Arabic nasab elements
  (`bin`/`ibn`/`ben` + father's name), and presence or absence of the Arabic
  article (`al-`, `el-`, `Al `, attached `Al`).
- Feminine Russian surname forms (Ivanova/Ivanov).

Names do not correspond when the given name or the family name is a different
name (Hassan is not Hussein, Ahmadi is not Ahmadi-with-a-different-given-name,
Al-Noor Trading is not Al-Noor Shipping). A single shared given name or a
single shared family name is not a name match.

## Rule 3: aliases

A `strong` alias is an alternative name of the entry and participates in
Rule 2 exactly like `primary_name`. A `weak` alias (a nickname or nom de
guerre) matches a customer only when the customer's name equals the alias and
Rule 4 corroborates with an identical full date of birth, or Rule 1 applies.
A weak alias alone never produces a match.

## Rule 4: date of birth

Dates of birth are compared only when both sides have one. A full customer
date must equal the entry's full date. A customer year or year-month must be
a prefix of the entry's date. Any disagreement rules the candidate out (the
customer is a different person with a similar name). A missing date on either
side neither confirms nor rules out.

## Rule 5: entities and vessels

Entity names correspond when all name words correspond after removing legal
form designators (LLC, L.L.C., Limited Liability Company, Ltd, Limited, S.A.,
GmbH, JSC, Joint Stock Company, AO, OAO, PJSC, Co., Company, FZE, FZ-LLC and
similar), leading `The`, punctuation, and the words `and`/`&`; case is
ignored. Vessel names correspond after removing prefixes such as `M/V`, `MV`,
`M/T`, `MT`, `Vessel`. Identifiers (`registration`, `imo`) match under Rule 1.

## Rule 6: nationality

Nationality is informational and does not confirm or rule out a match.

## Output

`/app/decisions.csv` with a header row `customer_id,decision,matched_uid`,
exactly one row per customer in the batch, `decision` in `{MATCH, NO_MATCH}`,
and `matched_uid` set to the entry `uid` for every `MATCH`. When more than one
entry could match, choose the one supported by an identifier, then by a date
of birth, then the lowest `uid` (string order). Closeness of spelling is not a
tie-breaker: two entries with the same name and different dates of birth are
two people, and a customer without a date of birth resolves to the lower `uid`.

## Scoring

The batch is scored against hidden labels produced by the same process as
`/app/dev/labels_dev.csv`, and the engine `/app/screen.py` is run on a second,
unseen batch from the same process and scored the same way. The task passes
only if all of the following hold on each batch: overall recall of true matches at least 0.97 and overall precision
at least 0.97; recall at least 0.90 within every true-match variation class;
false-positive rate at most 0.05 within every look-alike decoy class and at
most 0.01 among unrelated customers; and at least 0.97 of correct matches
carry the correct `matched_uid`. The development sample reports the same
classes so you can measure yourself before the batch is scored.

input.command:
python3 -c "
import json, collections, re, unicodedata
W=json.load(open('watchlist.json'))
tok=collections.Counter()
for e in W:
    if e['type']!='individual': continue
    for n in [e['primary_name']]+[a['name'] for a in e['aliases'] if a['strength']=='strong']:
        if any(ord(c)>0x3ff for c in n): continue
        for t in re.split(r'[\s,]+', n):
            if t: tok[t]+=1
print(len(tok))
print(' '.join(sorted(tok)))
"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sanctions screening engine.

Matches customer records against a sanctions watchlist under the rules in
screening_policy.md: transliteration equivalence across Arabic, Persian and
Cyrillic romanizations, name-order / particle / patronymic variation,
nicknames, strong and weak aliases, entity legal-form designators, vessel
prefixes, date-of-birth corroboration and identifier matches.

Standard library only.  Usage:

    python3 screen.py --watchlist watchlist.json --customers customers.csv \
                      --out decisions.csv
"""

import argparse
import csv
import json
import re
import sys
import unicodedata
from collections import defaultdict

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# script detection / folding
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ARABIC_RE = re.compile(r'[؀-ۿݐ-ݿﭐ-﷿ﹰ-﻿]')
CYRILLIC_RE = re.compile(r'[Ѐ-ӿ]')

CYR_MAP = {
    'а': 'a', 'б': 'b', 'в': 'v', 'г': 'g', 'д': 'd', 'е': 'e', 'ё': 'y0',
    'ж': 'zh', 'з': 'z', 'и': 'i', 'й': 'y', 'к': 'k', 'л': 'l', 'м': 'm',
    'н': 'n', 'о': 'o', 'п': 'p', 'р': 'r', 'с': 's', 'т': 't', 'у': 'u',
    'ф': 'f', 'х': 'kh', 'ц': 'ts', 'ч': 'ch', 'ш': 'sh', 'щ': 'shch',
    'ъ': '', 'ы': 'y', 'ь': '', 'э': 'e', 'ю': 'yu', 'я': 'ya',
    'і': 'i', 'ї': 'yi', 'є': 'ye', 'ґ': 'g', 'ў': 'u', 'ј': 'y', 'ђ': 'dj',
    'ћ': 'ch', 'џ': 'dzh', 'њ': 'n', 'љ': 'l',
}

PRE_FOLD = {
    'ß': 'ss', 'ø': 'o', 'æ': 'ae', 'œ': 'oe', 'đ': 'd', 'ð': 'd',
    'þ': 'th', 'ł': 'l', 'ı': 'i', 'İ': 'i', 'Ø': 'o', 'Æ': 'ae',
    'ẞ': 'ss', 'ĳ': 'ij', 'å': 'a', 'Å': 'a',
}


def cyr_to_latin(s):
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        low = ch.lower()
        if low in CYR_MAP:
            out.append(CYR_MAP[low])
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return ''.join(out)


def fold(s):
    """Lowercase, expand special letters, strip combining marks."""
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        if ch in PRE_FOLD:
            out.append(PRE_FOLD[ch])
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    s = ''.join(out)
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s)
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    return s.lower()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# latin -> phoneme keys
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

VOWEL_LETTERS = set('aeiouy0')

# vowel letter -> possible abstract vowel classes
VCLASS = {
    'a': 'a',
    'e': 'ai',
    'i': 'i',
    'o': 'u',
    'u': 'u',
    'y': 'i',
    '0': 'aiu',   # russian yo / any reduced vowel
}

# multi-character consonant clusters, longest first
CLUSTERS = [
    ('schtsch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('stsch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('shch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('shtch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('chtch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('zsch', ['W']),
    ('tsch', ['C']),
    ('dsch', ['J']),
    ('sch', ['W', 'SK']),
    ('tch', ['C']),
    ('dzh', ['J']),
    ('dzs', ['J']),
    ('ssz', ['W', 'S']),
    ('sh', ['W']),
    ('zh', ['W']),
    ('ch', ['C', 'W', 'H', 'K']),
    ('cz', ['C']),
    ('sz', ['W', 'S']),
    ('dj', ['J']),
    ('dz', ['J', 'DS']),
    ('ck', ['K']),
    ('kh', ['H']),
    ('gh', ['G', 'K', 'H']),
    ('th', ['T', 'S']),
    ('ph', ['F']),
    ('ts', ['TS', 'S']),
    ('tz', ['TS', 'S']),
    ('cs', ['C']),
    ('qu', ['K', 'KF']),
    ('ng', ['NG', 'N']),
    ('gn', ['GN', 'N']),
    ('wh', ['F']),
    ('gu', ['G', 'GF']),
]

SINGLE = {
    'b': ['B'], 'c': ['K', 'S', 'TS', 'C', 'J'], 'd': ['D'], 'f': ['F'],
    'g': ['G', 'J'], 'h': ['H'], 'j': ['J', 'W', 'Y'], 'k': ['K'],
    'l': ['L'], 'm': ['M'], 'n': ['N'], 'p': ['P'], 'q': ['K', 'G'],
    'r': ['R'], 's': ['S', 'W'], 't': ['T'], 'v': ['F'], 'w': ['F'],
    'x': ['KS', 'S'], 'z': ['S', 'W'],
}

MAX_KEYS = 6000


def _collapse_doubles(w):
    out = []
    prev = ''
    for ch in w:
        if ch == prev and ch not in VOWEL_LETTERS:
            continue
        out.append(ch)
        prev = ch
    return ''.join(out)


def _segment(w):
    """Split a folded latin word into segments.

    Returns a list of (kind, alternatives) where kind is 'c' (consonant) or
    'v' (vowel run).  Each alternative for a vowel run is a *single* vowel
    class char, optionally prefixed by 'Y'.
    """
    segs = []
    i = 0
    n = len(w)
    while i < n:
        ch = w[i]
        if ch in VOWEL_LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and w[j] in VOWEL_LETTERS:
                j += 1
            run = w[i:j]
            classes = set()
            for c in run:
                classes.update(VCLASS[c])
            alts = set(classes)
            if len(run) > 1 and run[0] in 'yi':
                rest = set()
                for c in run[1:]:
                    rest.update(VCLASS[c])
                for c in rest:
                    alts.add('Y' + c)
                    alts.add(c)
            segs.append(('v', sorted(alts), len(run)))
            i = j
            continue
        matched = False
        for pat, alts in CLUSTERS:
            if w.startswith(pat, i):
                # 'gu' only counts as hard g before a front vowel
                if pat == 'gu' and not (i + 2 < n and w[i + 2] in 'eiy'):
                    continue
                segs.append(('c', list(alts), len(pat)))
                i += len(pat)
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            continue
        if ch in SINGLE:
            alts = list(SINGLE[ch])
            if ch == 'j' and i + 1 < n and w[i + 1] in 'eou0':
                alts = alts + ['']
            if ch == 'h' and i == n - 1:
                alts = alts + ['']
            segs.append(('c', alts, 1))
        i += 1
    return segs


def _expand(segs, skeleton):
    """Cross-product the segment alternatives into key strings."""
    results = ['']
    last_v = -1
    for idx, (kind, alts, ln) in enumerate(segs):
        if kind == 'v':
            last_v = idx
    for idx, (kind, alts, ln) in enumerate(segs):
        if kind == 'v':
            opts = set()
            for a in alts:
                if skeleton:
                    opts.add(a.upper())
                else:
                    opts.add(a)
            if idx == last_v:
                # trailing vowel is flexible (arabic ta marbuta, added -e)
                for extra in ('a', 'i'):
                    opts.add(extra.upper() if skeleton else extra)
            if skeleton and ln == 1:
                # a single written vowel may render an arabic short vowel
                opts.add('')
        else:
            opts = set(alts)
        new = []
        for r in results:
            for o in opts:
                new.append(r + o)
            if len(new) > MAX_KEYS:
                break
        results = list(set(new))
        if len(results) > MAX_KEYS:
            results = results[:MAX_KEYS]
    return set(results)


ARTICLE_RE = re.compile(r'^(?:[aeiou](?:l|ll|d|dd|n|nn|r|rr|s|ss|t|tt|z|zz|sh|ch|sch)|al|el)[- ]?')


def _word_forms(w):
    """String level variants of one latin word: trailing h/e drops, article."""
    forms = set()
    base = _collapse_doubles(w)
    stack = [base]
    seen = set()
    while stack:
        x = stack.pop()
        if x in seen or not x:
            continue
        seen.add(x)
        forms.add(x)
        if len(x) > 2 and x[-1] == 'h':
            stack.append(x[:-1])
        if len(x) > 2 and x[-1] == 'e':
            stack.append(x[:-1])
    extra = set()
    for f in forms:
        m = ARTICLE_RE.match(f)
        if m and len(f) - m.end() >= 3:
            extra.add(_collapse_doubles(f[m.end():]))
    forms |= extra
    return forms


_latin_cache = {}


def latin_keys(word):
    """Return (full_keys, skeleton_keys) for one latin word."""
    if word in _latin_cache:
        return _latin_cache[word]
    w = fold(word)
    w = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", '', w)
    # mark russian yo
    w = re.sub(r'(?<=[yij])o(?=[bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxz])', '0', w)
    if not w:
        res = (frozenset(), frozenset())
        _latin_cache[word] = res
        return res
    full = set()
    skel = set()
    for form in _word_forms(w):
        segs = _segment(form)
        if not segs:
            continue
        full |= _expand(segs, False)
        skel |= _expand(segs, True)
    res = (frozenset(full), frozenset(skel))
    _latin_cache[word] = res
    return res


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# arabic / persian -> phoneme keys
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# consonant map -> list of alternatives
AR_CONS = {
    'ب': ['B'],                    # beh
    'پ': ['P'],                    # peh
    'ت': ['T'],                    # teh
    'ث': ['T', 'S'],               # theh
    'ج': ['J'],                    # jeem
    'چ': ['C'],                    # cheh
    'ح': ['H'],                    # hah
    'خ': ['H'],                    # khah
    'د': ['D'],                    # dal
    'ذ': ['S', 'D'],               # thal
    'ر': ['R'],                    # reh
    'ز': ['S'],                    # zain
    'ژ': ['W'],                    # jeh (zh)
    'س': ['S'],                    # seen
    'ش': ['W'],                    # sheen
    'ص': ['S'],                    # sad
    'ض': ['D', 'S'],               # dad
    'ط': ['T'],                    # tah
    'ظ': ['S', 'T'],               # zah
    'ع': [''],                     # ain
    'غ': ['G', 'K', 'H'],          # ghain
    'ف': ['F'],                    # feh
    'ق': ['K', 'G'],               # qaf
    'ك': ['K'],                    # kaf
    'ک': ['K'],                    # keheh
    'گ': ['G'],                    # gaf
    'ل': ['L'],                    # lam
    'م': ['M'],                    # meem
    'ن': ['N'],                    # noon
    'ه': ['H'],                    # heh
    'ھ': ['H'],
    'ء': [''],                     # hamza
    'ؤ': ['', 'F'],                # waw with hamza
    'ئ': ['', 'Y'],                # yeh with hamza
}

AR_LONG = {
    'ا': ['A'],                    # alef
    'آ': ['A'],                    # alef madda
    'أ': ['A', 'I', 'U'],          # alef hamza above
    'إ': ['I', 'A'],               # alef hamza below
    'و': ['U', 'F', 'A'],          # waw
    'ي': ['I', 'Y'],               # yeh
    'ی': ['I', 'Y'],               # farsi yeh
    'ى': ['A', 'I'],               # alef maksura
    'ے': ['I', 'Y'],               # yeh barree
}

AR_TAMARBUTA = 'ة'
AR_DIACRITICS = set('ًٌٍَُِّْٓ'
                    'ٕٔـٰ')

_arabic_cache = {}


def arabic_keys(word):
    """Return the set of consonant+long-vowel skeleton keys for an arabic word."""
    if word in _arabic_cache:
        return _arabic_cache[word]
    w = ''.join(ch for ch in word if ch not in AR_DIACRITICS)
    w = w.replace('ٱ', 'ا')
    forms = [w]
    # definite article
    if w.startswith('ال') and len(w) > 4:
        forms.append(w[2:])
    out = set()
    for form in forms:
        results = ['']
        for idx, ch in enumerate(form):
            if ch in AR_CONS:
                alts = list(AR_CONS[ch])
                if ch in ('ه', 'ھ') and idx == len(form) - 1:
                    alts = alts + ['', 'A', 'I']
            elif ch in AR_LONG:
                alts = list(AR_LONG[ch])
                if idx == 0:
                    alts = list(set(alts) | {'A', 'I', 'U'})
            elif ch == AR_TAMARBUTA:
                alts = ['', 'A', 'I']
            else:
                continue
            new = []
            for r in results:
                for a in alts:
                    new.append(r + a)
            results = list(set(new))
            if len(results) > MAX_KEYS:
                results = results[:MAX_KEYS]
        out |= set(results)
    res = frozenset(out)
    _arabic_cache[word] = res
    return res


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# token objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Tok(object):
    __slots__ = ('raw', 'arabic', 'lk', 'sk')

    def __init__(self, raw):
        self.raw = raw
        if ARABIC_RE.search(raw):
            self.arabic = True
            self.lk = frozenset()
            self.sk = arabic_keys(raw)
        else:
            self.arabic = False
            src = cyr_to_latin(raw) if CYRILLIC_RE.search(raw) else raw
            self.lk, self.sk = latin_keys(src)


_tok_cache = {}


def get_tok(raw):
    t = _tok_cache.get(raw)
    if t is None:
        t = Tok(raw)
        _tok_cache[raw] = t
    return t


def join_toks(a, b):
    """Concatenated token (compound surname)."""
    raw = a.raw + '§' + b.raw
    t = _tok_cache.get(raw)
    if t is not None:
        return t
    t = Tok.__new__(Tok)
    t.raw = raw
    t.arabic = a.arabic or b.arabic
    if a.arabic or b.arabic:
        t.lk = frozenset()
    else:
        t.lk = frozenset(x + y for x in a.lk for y in b.lk) if (
            len(a.lk) * len(b.lk) <= MAX_KEYS) else frozenset(
            list(x + y for x in a.lk for y in b.lk)[:MAX_KEYS])
    sk = set()
    cnt = 0
    for x in a.sk:
        for y in b.sk:
            sk.add(x + y)
            cnt += 1
            if cnt > MAX_KEYS:
                break
        if cnt > MAX_KEYS:
            break
    t.sk = frozenset(sk)
    _tok_cache[raw] = t
    return t


def tok_match(a, b):
    if a is b:
        return True
    if a.arabic or b.arabic:
        return not a.sk.isdisjoint(b.sk)
    return not a.lk.isdisjoint(b.lk)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# nicknames / given-name equivalences
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

NICK_GROUPS = [
    ['william', 'bill', 'billy', 'will', 'willie', 'wil', 'liam', 'willy'],

    ['virginia', 'ginny'],
    ['theresa', 'terry', 'tess', 'teresa'],
    ['josephine', 'josie'],
    ['caroline', 'carrie', 'carol', 'carolyn'],
    ['charlotte', 'lottie'],
    ['eleanor', 'ellie', 'nell'],
    ['frances', 'fran', 'franny'],
    ['jacqueline', 'jackie'],
    ['judith', 'judy'],
    ['laura', 'laurie'],
    ['martha', 'mattie'],
    ['stephanie', 'steph'],
    ['vivian', 'viv'],
    ['abigail', 'abby'],
    ['nathaniel', 'nate', 'nathan'],
]

NICK = defaultdict(set)
for _grp in NICK_GROUPS:
    for _a in _grp:
        NICK[_a].update(_grp)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# name parsing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PARTICLES = {
    'al', 'el', 'ul', 'il', 'ash', 'ad', 'an', 'ar', 'as', 'at', 'az',
    'esh', 'ech', 'esch', 'ed', 'en', 'er', 'es', 'et', 'ez',
    'la', 'le', 'de', 'del', 'della', 'da', 'dos', 'das', 'du', 'van',
    'von', 'der', 'den', 'ter', 'te', 'di', 'do', 'lo', 'bin', 'ibn',
    'ben', 'bint', 'binti', 'binte', 'bn', 'b', 'abu', 'umm', 'ould',
    'ait', 'ap', 'mac', 'mc', 'saint', 'st', 'the', 'a',
}
NASAB = {'bin', 'ibn', 'ben', 'bint', 'binti', 'binte', 'bn', 'b',
         'بن', 'ابن', 'بنت'}
DROP_TOKENS = {'jr', 'sr', 'ii', 'iii', 'iv', 'mr', 'mrs', 'ms', 'dr',
               'prof', 'sheikh', 'hajji', 'haji'}

ABD_RE = re.compile(r'^abd')
AR_ABD = {'عبد'}


def split_tokens(name):
    s = name.replace('’', "'").replace('ʼ', "'")
    s = re.sub(r"[.,;/\\()\[\]\"]", ' ', s)
    s = s.replace('-', ' ').replace('_', ' ')
    s = re.sub(r"'", '', s)
    return [t for t in s.split() if t]


def _strip_article_prefix(tok_str):
    f = fold(tok_str)
    m = ARTICLE_RE.match(f)
    if m and len(f) - m.end() >= 3:
        return f[m.end():]
    return f


class ParsedName(object):
    __slots__ = ('core', 'pairs', 'single', 'ntok', 'full_toks')

    def __init__(self, core, full_toks):
        self.core = core
        self.full_toks = full_toks
        self.ntok = len(core)
        self.single = core[0] if len(core) == 1 else None
        self.pairs = build_pairs(core)


def build_pairs(core):
    n = len(core)
    pairs = []
    if n < 2:
        return pairs
    if n == 2:
        pairs.append((core[0], core[1]))
        pairs.append((core[1], core[0]))
        return pairs
    a, z = core[0], core[-1]
    pairs.append((a, z))
    pairs.append((z, a))
    j_last = join_toks(core[-2], core[-1])
    pairs.append((a, j_last))
    pairs.append((j_last, a))
    j_first = join_toks(core[0], core[1])
    pairs.append((j_first, z))
    pairs.append((z, j_first))
    if n == 3:
        pairs.append((core[0], core[1]))
        pairs.append((core[1], core[0]))
        pairs.append((core[1], core[2]))
        pairs.append((core[2], core[1]))
    return pairs


PATRONYMIC_RE = re.compile(
    r'(?:vich|vitch|vitsch|witch|witsch|wich|vicz|wicz|vic|wic|'
    r'vna|wna|vnja|wnja)$')


def is_patronymic(folded):
    return bool(PATRONYMIC_RE.search(folded)) and len(folded) > 6


def parse_name(name, kind='individual'):
    toks = split_tokens(name)
    if not toks:
        return ParsedName([], [])
    # comma handling: "Family, Given ..." -> reorder is unnecessary because
    # candidate pairs consider both orders.
    folded = []
    for t in toks:
        if ARABIC_RE.search(t) or CYRILLIC_RE.search(t):
            folded.append(t)
        else:
            folded.append(fold(t))
    core = []
    i = 0
    n = len(folded)
    while i < n:
        t = folded[i]
        ft = t if (ARABIC_RE.search(t) or CYRILLIC_RE.search(t)) else t
        low = ft
        if low in DROP_TOKENS:
            i += 1
            continue
        if len(low) == 1 and not ARABIC_RE.search(low):
            i += 1
            continue
        if low in NASAB and i + 1 < n:
            # drop "bin <father>" when enough name material remains
            remaining = n - (i + 2)
            if len(core) + remaining >= 2:
                i += 2
                continue
            else:
                i += 1
                continue
        if low in PARTICLES and i + 1 < n:
            # article: merge into following token (handled by key variants)
            nxt = folded[i + 1]
            folded[i + 1] = low + nxt if not ARABIC_RE.search(nxt) else nxt
            i += 1
            continue
        if not ARABIC_RE.search(low) and is_patronymic(low):
            remaining = n - (i + 1)
            if len(core) + remaining >= 2:
                i += 1
                continue
        # abd- compounds
        if not ARABIC_RE.search(low) and ABD_RE.match(low) and len(low) <= 6 \
                and i + 1 < n:
            nxt = folded[i + 1]
            if not ARABIC_RE.search(nxt):
                nxt2 = _strip_article_prefix(nxt)
                core.append(('abd', nxt2))
            else:
                core.append(('abd', nxt))
            i += 2
            continue
        if low in AR_ABD and i + 1 < n:
            core.append(('abd', folded[i + 1]))
            i += 2
            continue
        if not ARABIC_RE.search(low) and ABD_RE.match(low) and len(low) > 6:
            rest = low[3:]
            m = re.match(r'^[aeiou]?(?:l|ll|r|rr|n|nn|)', rest)
            if m:
                rest2 = rest[m.end():]
            else:
                rest2 = rest
            if len(rest2) >= 3:
                core.append(('abd', rest2))
                i += 1
                continue
        core.append(low)
        i += 1
    out = []
    for c in core:
        if isinstance(c, tuple):
            out.append(join_toks(get_tok('abd'), get_tok(c[1])))
        else:
            out.append(get_tok(c))
    return ParsedName(out, [get_tok(x if not isinstance(x, tuple) else x[1])
                            for x in core])


def given_tok_set(tok):
    """Expand nicknames for a given-name token."""
    base = tok.raw
    alts = NICK.get(base)
    if not alts:
        return [tok]
    return [tok] + [get_tok(a) for a in alts if a != base]


FEM_SUFFIX = [
    ('ova', 'ov'), ('eva', 'ev'), ('yova', 'yov'), ('iova', 'iov'),
    ('owa', 'ow'), ('ewa', 'ew'), ('ffa', 'ff'), ('offa', 'off'),
    ('ina', 'in'), ('yna', 'yn'), ('skaya', 'ski'), ('tskaya', 'tski'),
    ('aya', 'y'), ('cka', 'cki'), ('ska', 'ski'), ('a', ''),
]


def family_tok_set(tok):
    """Russian/Slavic feminine surname forms map to the masculine stem."""
    if tok.arabic:
        return [tok]
    raw = tok.raw
    outs = [tok]
    for suf, rep in FEM_SUFFIX:
        if raw.endswith(suf) and len(raw) - len(suf) >= 3:
            if suf == 'a' and not re.search(
                    r'(ov|ev|in|yn|ow|ew|ff|sk|tsk|zk|ck)a$', raw):
                continue
            outs.append(get_tok(raw[:len(raw) - len(suf)] + rep))
            break
    return outs


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# entity / vessel names
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

LEGAL_PHRASES = [
    'public joint stock company', 'joint stock company',
    'limited liability company', 'free zone establishment',
    'free zone company', 'sociedad anonima', 'open joint stock company',
    'closed joint stock company', 'private joint stock company',
    'public limited company', 'and company',
]
LEGAL_TOKENS = {
    'llc', 'lllc', 'ltd', 'limited', 'sa', 'gmbh', 'jsc', 'ao', 'oao',
    'zao', 'pjsc', 'ojsc', 'co', 'company', 'corp', 'corporation', 'inc',
    'incorporated', 'fze', 'fzllc', 'fzco', 'fz', 'plc', 'ag', 'nv', 'bv',
    'srl', 'spa', 'pte', 'pvt', 'llp', 'lp', 'kg', 'ohg', 'oy', 'ab',
    'as', 'sarl', 'sas', 'sl', 'kft', 'doo', 'dd', 'joint', 'stock',
    'liability', 'establishment', 'sociedad', 'anonima', 'zone',
    'the', 'and', 'of', '公司',
}
VESSEL_PREFIX = {'mv', 'mt', 'ms', 'ss', 'mts', 'mtv', 'vessel', 'motor',
                 'tanker', 'the', 'm', 'v', 't', 's'}

ENT_EQUIV = {
    'bosporus': 'bosphorus',
}


def norm_org(name, vessel=False):
    s = fold(name)
    s = s.replace('&', ' and ')
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9؀-ۿЀ-ӿ]+', ' ', s)
    s = ' ' + ' '.join(s.split()) + ' '
    for ph in LEGAL_PHRASES:
        s = s.replace(' ' + ph + ' ', ' ')
    toks = s.split()
    out = []
    for t in toks:
        if t in LEGAL_TOKENS:
            continue
        if vessel and not out and t in VESSEL_PREFIX:
            continue
        out.append(ENT_EQUIV.get(t, t))
    if vessel:
        while out and out[0] in VESSEL_PREFIX:
            out.pop(0)
    return tuple(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# dates
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def dob_parts(d):
    if not d:
        return None
    d = d.strip()
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{4})(?:-(\d{1,2}))?(?:-(\d{1,2}))?$', d)
    if not m:
        return None
    parts = [m.group(1)]
    if m.group(2):
        parts.append('%02d' % int(m.group(2)))
    if m.group(3):
        parts.append('%02d' % int(m.group(3)))
    return parts


def dob_check(cust, entry):
    """Returns (compatible, corroborated)."""
    a = dob_parts(cust)
    b = dob_parts(entry)
    if a is None or b is None:
        return True, False
    n = min(len(a), len(b))
    if a[:n] == b[:n]:
        return True, True
    return False, False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# watchlist index
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class EntryName(object):
    __slots__ = ('uid', 'parsed', 'weak', 'raw')

    def __init__(self, uid, raw, parsed, weak):
        self.uid = uid
        self.raw = raw
        self.parsed = parsed
        self.weak = weak


class Engine(object):
    def __init__(self, entries):
        self.entries = {}
        self.by_id = {}
        self.person_names = []
        self.tok_index = defaultdict(set)   # key -> set(name idx)
        self.org_index = defaultdict(set)   # word tuple -> set(uid)
        self.weak_index = defaultdict(list)
        self.org_names = {}
        for e in entries:
            uid = e['uid']
            self.entries[uid] = e
            for ident in e.get('ids') or []:
                key = (str(ident.get('type', '')).strip().lower(),
                       re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '',
                              str(ident.get('number', ''))).upper())
                if key[1]:
                    self.by_id.setdefault(key, []).append(uid)
            typ = e.get('type', 'individual')
            names = []
            if e.get('primary_name'):
                names.append((e['primary_name'], 'strong'))
            if e.get('script_name'):
                names.append((e['script_name'], 'strong'))
            for a in e.get('aliases') or []:
                names.append((a['name'], a.get('strength', 'strong')))
            if typ == 'individual':
                for raw, strength in names:
                    if strength == 'weak':
                        pn = parse_name(raw)
                        self.weak_index[weak_key(raw)].append(uid)
                        continue
                    pn = parse_name(raw)
                    idx = len(self.person_names)
                    self.person_names.append(EntryName(uid, raw, pn, False))
                    seen = set()
                    for t in pn.core:
                        for k in t.sk:
                            if k not in seen:
                                seen.add(k)
                                self.tok_index[k].add(idx)
            else:
                vessel = (typ == 'vessel')
                for raw, strength in names:
                    if strength == 'weak':
                        self.weak_index[weak_key(raw)].append(uid)
                        continue
                    key = norm_org(raw, vessel)
                    if key:
                        self.org_index[key].add(uid)

    def candidates(self, parsed):
        cands = set()
        for t in parsed.core:
            for k in t.sk:
                s = self.tok_index.get(k)
                if s:
                    cands |= s
        return cands


def weak_key(raw):
    toks = split_tokens(raw)
    return ' '.join(fold(t) for t in toks)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# name matching
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def names_match(a, b):
    """a, b: ParsedName - do they refer to the same person?"""
    if not a.pairs or not b.pairs:
        return False
    for (g1, f1) in a.pairs:
        g1s = given_tok_set(g1)
        f1s = family_tok_set(f1)
        for (g2, f2) in b.pairs:
            ok = False
            for x in g1s:
                for y in given_tok_set(g2):
                    if tok_match(x, y):
                        ok = True
                        break
                if ok:
                    break
            if not ok:
                continue
            ok = False
            for x in f1s:
                for y in family_tok_set(f2):
                    if tok_match(x, y):
                        ok = True
                        break
                if ok:
                    break
            if ok:
                return True
    return False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# screening
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def screen_customer(row, eng):
    cid = row.get('customer_id', '')
    name = (row.get('full_name') or '').strip()
    dob = (row.get('dob') or '').strip()
    ctype = (row.get('type') or 'individual').strip().lower()
    id_type = (row.get('id_type') or '').strip().lower()
    id_num = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', (row.get('id_number') or '')).upper()

    # Rule 1: identifiers
    if id_type and id_num:
        uids = eng.by_id.get((id_type, id_num))
        if uids:
            return sorted(uids)[0]

    results = []   # (dob_supported, uid)

    if ctype == 'individual':
        parsed = parse_name(name)
        for idx in eng.candidates(parsed):
            en = eng.person_names[idx]
            e = eng.entries[en.uid]
            if e.get('type') != 'individual':
                continue
            ok, corr = dob_check(dob, e.get('dob', ''))
            if not ok:
                continue
            if names_match(parsed, en.parsed):
                results.append((corr, en.uid))
    else:
        vessel = (ctype == 'vessel')
        key = norm_org(name, vessel)
        uids = eng.org_index.get(key)
        if uids:
            for uid in uids:
                e = eng.entries[uid]
                if e.get('type') == 'individual':
                    continue
                results.append((False, uid))
        if not results and key:
            key2 = norm_org(name, True)
            uids = eng.org_index.get(key2)
            if uids:
                for uid in uids:
                    e = eng.entries[uid]
                    if e.get('type') == 'individual':
                        continue
                    results.append((False, uid))

    # Rule 3: weak aliases need an identical full date of birth
    if len(dob_parts(dob) or []) == 3:
        wk = weak_key(name)
        for uid in eng.weak_index.get(wk, []):
            e = eng.entries[uid]
            if dob_parts(e.get('dob', '')) == dob_parts(dob):
                results.append((True, uid))

    if not results:
        return None
    results.sort(key=lambda r: (not r[0], r[1]))
    return results[0][1]


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--watchlist', required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--customers', required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--out', required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    with open(args.watchlist, encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        wl = json.load(fh)
    eng = Engine(wl)

    with open(args.customers, encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as fh:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(fh))

    with open(args.out, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(['customer_id', 'decision', 'matched_uid'])
        for row in rows:
            uid = screen_customer(row, eng)
            if uid:
                w.writerow([row.get('customer_id', ''), 'MATCH', uid])
            else:
                w.writerow([row.get('customer_id', ''), 'NO_MATCH', ''])
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sanctions screening engine.

Matches customer records against a sanctions watchlist under the rules in
screening_policy.md: transliteration equivalence across Arabic, Persian and
Cyrillic romanizations, name-order / particle / patronymic variation,
nicknames, strong and weak aliases, entity legal-form designators, vessel
prefixes, date-of-birth corroboration and identifier matches.

Standard library only.  Usage:

    python3 screen.py --watchlist watchlist.json --customers customers.csv \
                      --out decisions.csv
"""

import argparse
import csv
import json
import re
import sys
import unicodedata
from collections import defaultdict

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# script detection / folding
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ARABIC_RE = re.compile(r'[؀-ۿݐ-ݿﭐ-﷿ﹰ-﻿]')
CYRILLIC_RE = re.compile(r'[Ѐ-ӿ]')

CYR_MAP = {
    'а': 'a', 'б': 'b', 'в': 'v', 'г': 'g', 'д': 'd', 'е': 'e', 'ё': 'y0',
    'ж': 'zh', 'з': 'z', 'и': 'i', 'й': 'y', 'к': 'k', 'л': 'l', 'м': 'm',
    'н': 'n', 'о': 'o', 'п': 'p', 'р': 'r', 'с': 's', 'т': 't', 'у': 'u',
    'ф': 'f', 'х': 'kh', 'ц': 'ts', 'ч': 'ch', 'ш': 'sh', 'щ': 'shch',
    'ъ': '', 'ы': 'y', 'ь': '', 'э': 'e', 'ю': 'yu', 'я': 'ya',
    'і': 'i', 'ї': 'yi', 'є': 'ye', 'ґ': 'g', 'ў': 'u', 'ј': 'y', 'ђ': 'dj',
    'ћ': 'ch', 'џ': 'dzh', 'њ': 'n', 'љ': 'l',
}

PRE_FOLD = {
    'ß': 'ss', 'ø': 'o', 'æ': 'ae', 'œ': 'oe', 'đ': 'd', 'ð': 'd',
    'þ': 'th', 'ł': 'l', 'ı': 'i', 'İ': 'i', 'Ø': 'o', 'Æ': 'ae',
    'ẞ': 'ss', 'ĳ': 'ij', 'å': 'a', 'Å': 'a',
}


def cyr_to_latin(s):
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        low = ch.lower()
        if low in CYR_MAP:
            out.append(CYR_MAP[low])
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return ''.join(out)


def fold(s):
    """Lowercase, expand special letters, strip combining marks."""
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        if ch in PRE_FOLD:
            out.append(PRE_FOLD[ch])
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    s = ''.join(out)
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s)
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    return s.lower()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# latin -> phoneme keys
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

VOWEL_LETTERS = set('aeiouy0')

# vowel letter -> possible abstract vowel classes
VCLASS = {
    'a': 'a',
    'e': 'ai',
    'i': 'i',
    'o': 'u',
    'u': 'u',
    'y': 'i',
    '0': 'aiu',   # russian yo / any reduced vowel
}

# multi-character consonant clusters, longest first
CLUSTERS = [
    ('schtsch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('stsch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('shch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('shtch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('chtch', ['WC', 'W']),
    ('zsch', ['W']),
    ('tsch', ['C']),
    ('dsch', ['J']),
    ('sch', ['W', 'SK']),
    ('tch', ['C']),
    ('dzh', ['J']),
    ('dzs', ['J']),
    ('ssz', ['W', 'S']),
    ('sh', ['W']),
    ('zh', ['W']),
    ('ch', ['C', 'W', 'H', 'K']),
    ('cz', ['C']),
    ('sz', ['W', 'S']),
    ('dj', ['J']),
    ('dz', ['J', 'DS']),
    ('ck', ['K']),
    ('kh', ['H']),
    ('gh', ['G', 'K', 'H']),
    ('th', ['T', 'S']),
    ('ph', ['F']),
    ('ts', ['TS', 'S']),
    ('tz', ['TS', 'S']),
    ('cs', ['C']),
    ('qu', ['K', 'KF']),
    ('ng', ['NG', 'N']),
    ('gn', ['GN', 'N']),
    ('wh', ['F']),
    ('gu', ['G', 'GF']),
]

SINGLE = {
    'b': ['B'], 'c': ['K', 'S', 'TS', 'C', 'J'], 'd': ['D'], 'f': ['F'],
    'g': ['G', 'J'], 'h': ['H'], 'j': ['J', 'W', 'Y'], 'k': ['K'],
    'l': ['L'], 'm': ['M'], 'n': ['N'], 'p': ['P'], 'q': ['K', 'G'],
    'r': ['R'], 's': ['S', 'W'], 't': ['T'], 'v': ['F'], 'w': ['F'],
    'x': ['KS', 'S'], 'z': ['S', 'W'],
}

MAX_KEYS = 6000


def _collapse_doubles(w):
    out = []
    prev = ''
    for ch in w:
        if ch == prev and ch not in VOWEL_LETTERS:
            continue
        out.append(ch)
        prev = ch
    return ''.join(out)


def _segment(w):
    """Split a folded latin word into segments.

    Returns a list of (kind, alternatives) where kind is 'c' (consonant) or
    'v' (vowel run).  Each alternative for a vowel run is a *single* vowel
    class char, optionally prefixed by 'Y'.
    """
    segs = []
    i = 0
    n = len(w)
    while i < n:
        ch = w[i]
        if ch in VOWEL_LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and w[j] in VOWEL_LETTERS:
                j += 1
            run = w[i:j]
            classes = set()
            for c in run:
                classes.update(VCLASS[c])
            alts = set(classes)
            if len(run) > 1 and run[0] in 'yi':
                rest = set()
                for c in run[1:]:
                    rest.update(VCLASS[c])
                for c in rest:
                    alts.add('Y' + c)
                    alts.add(c)
            segs.append(('v', sorted(alts), len(run)))
            i = j
            continue
        matched = False
        for pat, alts in CLUSTERS:
            if w.startswith(pat, i):
                # 'gu' only counts as hard g before a front vowel
                if pat == 'gu' and not (i + 2 < n and w[i + 2] in 'eiy'):
                    continue
                segs.append(('c', list(alts), len(pat)))
                i += len(pat)
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            continue
        if ch in SINGLE:
            alts = list(SINGLE[ch])
            if ch == 'j' and i + 1 < n and w[i + 1] in 'eou0':
                alts = alts + ['']
            if ch == 'h' and i == n - 1:
                alts = alts + ['']
            segs.append(('c', alts, 1))
        i += 1
    return segs


def _expand(segs, skeleton):
    """Cross-product the segment alternatives into key strings."""
    results = ['']
    last_v = -1
    for idx, (kind, alts, ln) in enumerate(segs):
        if kind == 'v':
            last_v = idx
    for idx, (kind, alts, ln) in enumerate(segs):
        if kind == 'v':
            opts = set()
            for a in alts:
                if skeleton:
                    opts.add(a.upper())
                else:
                    opts.add(a)
            if idx == last_v:
                # trailing vowel is flexible (arabic ta marbuta, added -e)
                for extra in ('a', 'i'):
                    opts.add(extra.upper() if skeleton else extra)
            if skeleton and ln == 1:
                # a single written vowel may render an arabic short vowel
                opts.add('')
        else:
            opts = set(alts)
        new = []
        for r in results:
            for o in opts:
                new.append(r + o)
            if len(new) > MAX_KEYS:
                break
        results = list(set(new))
        if len(results) > MAX_KEYS:
            results = results[:MAX_KEYS]
    return set(results)


ARTICLE_RE = re.compile(r'^(?:[aeiou](?:l|ll|d|dd|n|nn|r|rr|s|ss|t|tt|z|zz|sh|ch|sch)|al|el)[- ]?')


def _word_forms(w):
    """String level variants of one latin word: trailing h/e drops, article."""
    forms = set()
    base = _collapse_doubles(w)
    stack = [base]
    seen = set()
    while stack:
        x = stack.pop()
        if x in seen or not x:
            continue
        seen.add(x)
        forms.add(x)
        if len(x) > 2 and x[-1] == 'h':
            stack.append(x[:-1])
        if len(x) > 2 and x[-1] == 'e':
            stack.append(x[:-1])
    extra = set()
    for f in forms:
        m = ARTICLE_RE.match(f)
        if m and len(f) - m.end() >= 3:
            extra.add(_collapse_doubles(f[m.end():]))
    forms |= extra
    return forms


_latin_cache = {}


def latin_keys(word):
    """Return (full_keys, skeleton_keys) for one latin word."""
    if word in _latin_cache:
        return _latin_cache[word]
    w = fold(word)
    w = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", '', w)
    # mark russian yo
    w = re.sub(r'(?<=[yij])o(?=[bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxz])', '0', w)
    if not w:
        res = (frozenset(), frozenset())
        _latin_cache[word] = res
        return res
    full = set()
    skel = set()
    for form in _word_forms(w):
        segs = _segment(form)
        if not segs:
            continue
        full |= _expand(segs, False)
        skel |= _expand(segs, True)
    res = (frozenset(full), frozenset(skel))
    _latin_cache[word] = res
    return res

AR_TAMARBUTA = 'ة'
AR_DIACRITICS = set('ًٌٍَُِّْٓ'
                    'ٕٔـٰ')

_arabic_cache = {}


def arabic_keys(word):
    """Return the set of consonant+long-vowel skeleton keys for an arabic word."""
    if word in _arabic_cache:
        return _arabic_cache[word]
    w = ''.join(ch for ch in word if ch not in AR_DIACRITICS)
    w = w.replace('ٱ', 'ا')
    forms = [w]
    # definite article
    if w.startswith('ال') and len(w) > 4:
        forms.append(w[2:])
    out = set()
    for form in forms:
        results = ['']
        for idx, ch in enumerate(form):
            if ch in AR_CONS:
                alts = list(AR_CONS[ch])
                if ch in ('ه', 'ھ') and idx == len(form) - 1:
                    alts = alts + ['', 'A', 'I']
            elif ch in AR_LONG:
                alts = list(AR_LONG[ch])
                if idx == 0:
                    alts = list(set(alts) | {'A', 'I', 'U'})
            elif ch == AR_TAMARBUTA:
                alts = ['', 'A', 'I']
            else:
                continue
            new = []
            for r in results:
                for a in alts:
                    new.append(r + a)
            results = list(set(new))
            if len(results) > MAX_KEYS:
                results = results[:MAX_KEYS]
        out |= set(results)
    res = frozenset(out)
    _arabic_cache[word] = res
    return res

# token objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Tok(object):
    __slots__ = ('raw', 'arabic', 'lk', 'sk')

    def __init__(self, raw):
        self.raw = raw
        if ARABIC_RE.search(raw):
            self.arabic = True
            self.lk = frozenset()
            self.sk = arabic_keys(raw)
        else:
            self.arabic = False
            src = cyr_to_latin(raw) if CYRILLIC_RE.search(raw) else raw
            self.lk, self.sk = latin_keys(src)


_tok_cache = {}


def get_tok(raw):
    t = _tok_cache.get(raw)
    if t is None:
        t = Tok(raw)
        _tok_cache[raw] = t
    return t


def join_toks(a, b):
    """Concatenated token (compound surname)."""
    raw = a.raw + '§' + b.raw
    t = _tok_cache.get(raw)
    if t is not None:
        return t
    t = Tok.__new__(Tok)
    t.raw = raw
    t.arabic = a.arabic or b.arabic
    if a.arabic or b.arabic:
        t.lk = frozenset()
    else:
        t.lk = frozenset(x + y for x in a.lk for y in b.lk) if (
            len(a.lk) * len(b.lk) <= MAX_KEYS) else frozenset(
            list(x + y for x in a.lk for y in b.lk)[:MAX_KEYS])
    sk = set()
    cnt = 0
    for x in a.sk:
        for y in b.sk:
            sk.add(x + y)
            cnt += 1
            if cnt > MAX_KEYS:
                break
        if cnt > MAX_KEYS:
            break
    t.sk = frozenset(sk)
    _tok_cache[raw] = t
    return t


def tok_match(a, b):
    if a is b:
        return True
    if a.arabic or b.arabic:
        return not a.sk.isdisjoint(b.sk)
    return not a.lk.isdisjoint(b.lk)

    'esh', 'ech', 'esch', 'ed', 'en', 'er', 'es', 'et', 'ez',
    'la', 'le', 'de', 'del', 'della', 'da', 'dos', 'das', 'du', 'van',

    'ait', 'ap', 'mac', 'mc', 'saint', 'st', 'the', 'a',
}
NASAB = {'bin', 'ibn', 'ben', 'bint', 'binti', 'binte', 'bn', 'b',
         'بن', 'ابن', 'بنت'}
DROP_TOKENS = {'jr', 'sr', 'ii', 'iii', 'iv', 'mr', 'mrs', 'ms', 'dr',
               'prof', 'sheikh', 'hajji', 'haji'}

ABD_RE = re.compile(r'^abd')
AR_ABD = {'عبد'}


def split_tokens(name):
    s = name.replace('’', "'").replace('ʼ', "'")
    s = re.sub(r"[.,;/\\()\[\]\"]", ' ', s)
    s = s.replace('-', ' ').replace('_', ' ')
    s = re.sub(r"'", '', s)
    return [t for t in s.split() if t]


def _strip_article_prefix(tok_str):
    f = fold(tok_str)
    m = ARTICLE_RE.match(f)
    if m and len(f) - m.end() >= 3:
        return f[m.end():]
    return f


class ParsedName(object):
    __slots__ = ('core', 'pairs', 'single', 'ntok', 'full_toks')

    def __init__(self, core, full_toks):
        self.core = core
        self.full_toks = full_toks
        self.ntok = len(core)
        self.single = core[0] if len(core) == 1 else None
        self.pairs = build_pairs(core)


def build_pairs(core):
    n = len(core)
    pairs = []
    if n < 2:
        return pairs
    if n == 2:
        pairs.append((core[0], core[1]))
        pairs.append((core[1], core[0]))
        return pairs
    a, z = core[0], core[-1]
    pairs.append((a, z))
    pairs.append((z, a))
    j_last = join_toks(core[-2], core[-1])
    pairs.append((a, j_last))
    pairs.append((j_last, a))
    j_first = join_toks(core[0], core[1])
    pairs.append((j_first, z))
    pairs.append((z, j_first))
    if n == 3:
        pairs.append((core[0], core[1]))
        pairs.append((core[1], core[0]))
        pairs.append((core[1], core[2]))
        pairs.append((core[2], core[1]))
    return pairs


PATRONYMIC_RE = re.compile(
    r'(?:vich|vitch|vitsch|witch|witsch|wich|vicz|wicz|vic|wic|'
    r'vna|wna|vnja|wnja)$')


def is_patronymic(folded):
    return bool(PATRONYMIC_RE.search(folded)) and len(folded) > 6


def parse_name(name, kind='individual'):
    toks = split_tokens(name)
    if not toks:
        return ParsedName([], [])
    # comma handling: "Family, Given ..." -> reorder is unnecessary because
    # candidate pairs consider both orders.
    folded = []
    for t in toks:
        if ARABIC_RE.search(t) or CYRILLIC_RE.search(t):
            folded.append(t)
        else:
            folded.append(fold(t))
    core = []
    i = 0
    n = len(folded)
    while i < n:
        t = folded[i]
        ft = t if (ARABIC_RE.search(t) or CYRILLIC_RE.search(t)) else t
        low = ft
        if low in DROP_TOKENS:
            i += 1
            continue
        if len(low) == 1 and not ARABIC_RE.search(low):
            i += 1
            continue
        if low in NASAB and i + 1 < n:
            # drop "bin <father>" when enough name material remains
            remaining = n - (i + 2)
            if len(core) + remaining >= 2:
                i += 2
                continue
            else:
                i += 1
                continue
        if low in PARTICLES and i + 1 < n:
            # article: merge into following token (handled by key variants)
            nxt = folded[i + 1]
            folded[i + 1] = low + nxt if not ARABIC_RE.search(nxt) else nxt
            i += 1
            continue
        if not ARABIC_RE.search(low) and is_patronymic(low):
            remaining = n - (i + 1)
            if len(core) + remaining >= 2:
                i += 1
                continue
        # abd- compounds
        if not ARABIC_RE.search(low) and ABD_RE.match(low) and len(low) <= 6 \
                and i + 1 < n:
            nxt = folded[i + 1]
            if not ARABIC_RE.search(nxt):
                nxt2 = _strip_article_prefix(nxt)
                core.append(('abd', nxt2))
            else:
                core.append(('abd', nxt))
            i += 2
            continue
        if low in AR_ABD and i + 1 < n:
            core.append(('abd', folded[i + 1]))
            i += 2
            continue
        if not ARABIC_RE.search(low) and ABD_RE.match(low) and len(low) > 6:
            rest = low[3:]
            m = re.match(r'^[aeiou]?(?:l|ll|r|rr|n|nn|)', rest)
            if m:
                rest2 = rest[m.end():]
            else:
                rest2 = rest
            if len(rest2) >= 3:
                core.append(('abd', rest2))
                i += 1
                continue
        core.append(low)
        i += 1
    out = []
    for c in core:
        if isinstance(c, tuple):
            out.append(join_toks(get_tok('abd'), get_tok(c[1])))
        else:
            out.append(get_tok(c))
    return ParsedName(out, [get_tok(x if not isinstance(x, tuple) else x[1])
                            for x in core])


def given_tok_set(tok):
    """Expand nicknames for a given-name token."""
    base = tok.raw
    alts = NICK.get(base)
    if not alts:

    return [tok] + [get_tok(a) for a in alts if a != base]


FEM_SUFFIX = [
    ('ova', 'ov'), ('eva', 'ev'), ('yova', 'yov'), ('iova', 'iov'),
    ('owa', 'ow'), ('ewa', 'ew'), ('ffa', 'ff'), ('offa', 'off'),
    ('ina', 'in'), ('yna', 'yn'), ('skaya', 'ski'), ('tskaya', 'tski'),
    ('aya', 'y'), ('cka', 'cki'), ('ska', 'ski'), ('a', ''),
]


def family_tok_set(tok):
    """Russian/Slavic feminine surname forms map to the masculine stem."""
    if tok.arabic:
        return [tok]
    raw = tok.raw
    outs = [tok]
    for suf, rep in FEM_SUFFIX:
        if raw.endswith(suf) and len(raw) - len(suf) >= 3:
            if suf == 'a' and not re.search(
                    r'(ov|ev|in|yn|ow|ew|ff|sk|tsk|zk|ck)a$', raw):
                continue
            outs.append(get_tok(raw[:len(raw) - len(suf)] + rep))
            break
    return outs

    'bosporus': 'bosphorus',

def norm_org(name, vessel=False):
    s = fold(name)
    s = s.replace('&', ' and ')
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9؀-ۿЀ-ӿ]+', ' ', s)
    s = ' ' + ' '.join(s.split()) + ' '
    for ph in LEGAL_PHRASES:
        s = s.replace(' ' + ph + ' ', ' ')
    toks = s.split()
    out = []
    for t in toks:
        if t in LEGAL_TOKENS:
            continue
        if vessel and not out and t in VESSEL_PREFIX:
            continue
        out.append(ENT_EQUIV.get(t, t))
    if vessel:
        while out and out[0] in VESSEL_PREFIX:
            out.pop(0)
    return tuple(out)

def dob_parts(d):
    if not d:
        return None
    d = d.strip()
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{4})(?:-(\d{1,2}))?(?:-(\d{1,2}))?$', d)
    if not m:
        return None
    parts = [m.group(1)]
    if m.group(2):
        parts.append('%02d' % int(m.group(2)))
    if m.group(3):
        parts.append('%02d' % int(m.group(3)))
    return parts


def dob_check(cust, entry):
    """Returns (compatible, corroborated)."""
    a = dob_parts(cust)
    b = dob_parts(entry)
    if a is None or b is None:
        return True, False
    n = min(len(a), len(b))
    if a[:n] == b[:n]:
        return True, True
    return False, False

                names.append((e['primary_name'], 'strong'))
            if e.get('script_name'):
                names.append((e['script_name'], 'strong'))
            for a in e.get('aliases') or []:
                names.append((a['name'], a.get('strength', 'strong')))
            if typ == 'individual':
                for raw, strength in names:
                    if strength == 'weak':
                        pn = parse_name(raw)
                        self.weak_index[weak_key(raw)].append(uid)
                        continue
                    pn = parse_name(raw)
                    idx = len(self.person_names)
                    self.person_names.append(EntryName(uid, raw, pn, False))
                    seen = set()
                    for t in pn.core:
                        for k in t.sk:
                            if k not in seen:
                                seen.add(k)
                                self.tok_index[k].add(idx)
            else:
                vessel = (typ == 'vessel')
                for raw, strength in names:
                    if strength == 'weak':
                        self.weak_index[weak_key(raw)].append(uid)
                        continue
                    key = norm_org(raw, vessel)
                    if key:
                        self.org_index[key].add(uid)

    def candidates(self, parsed):
        cands = set()
        for t in parsed.core:
            for k in t.sk:
                s = self.tok_index.get(k)
                if s:
                    cands |= s
        return cands


def weak_key(raw):
    toks = split_tokens(raw)
    return ' '.join(fold(t) for t in toks)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# name matching
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def names_match(a, b):
    """a, b: ParsedName - do they refer to the same person?"""
    if not a.pairs or not b.pairs:
        return False
    for (g1, f1) in a.pairs:
        g1s = given_tok_set(g1)
        f1s = family_tok_set(f1)
        for (g2, f2) in b.pairs:
            ok = False
            for x in g1s:
                for y in given_tok_set(g2):
                    if tok_match(x, y):
                        ok = True
                        break
                if ok:
                    break
            if not ok:
                continue
            ok = False
            for x in f1s:
                for y in family_tok_set(f2):
                    if tok_match(x, y):
                        ok = True
                        break
                if ok:
                    break
            if ok:
                return True
    return False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# screening
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def screen_customer(row, eng):
    cid = row.get('customer_id', '')
    name = (row.get('full_name') or '').strip()
    dob = (row.get('dob') or '').strip()
    ctype = (row.get('type') or 'individual').strip().lower()
    id_type = (row.get('id_type') or '').strip().lower()
    id_num = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', (row.get('id_number') or '')).upper()

    # Rule 1: identifiers
    if id_type and id_num:
        uids = eng.by_id.get((id_type, id_num))
        if uids:
            return sorted(uids)[0]

    results = []   # (dob_supported, uid)

    if ctype == 'individual':
        parsed = parse_name(name)
        for idx in eng.candidates(parsed):
            en = eng.person_names[idx]
            e = eng.entries[en.uid]
            if e.get('type') != 'individual':
                continue
            ok, corr = dob_check(dob, e.get('dob', ''))
            if not ok:
                continue
            if names_match(parsed, en.parsed):
                results.append((corr, en.uid))
    else:
        vessel = (ctype == 'vessel')
        key = norm_org(name, vessel)
        uids = eng.org_index.get(key)
        if uids:
            for uid in uids:
                e = eng.entries[uid]
                if e.get('type') == 'individual':
                    continue
                results.append((False, uid))
        if not results and key:
            key2 = norm_org(name, True)
            uids = eng.org_index.get(key2)
            if uids:
                for uid in uids:
                    e = eng.entries[uid]
                    if e.get('type') == 'individual':
                        continue
                    results.append((False, uid))

    # Rule 3: weak aliases need an identical full date of birth
    if len(dob_parts(dob) or []) == 3:
        wk = weak_key(name)
        for uid in eng.weak_index.get(wk, []):
            e = eng.entries[uid]
            if dob_parts(e.get('dob', '')) == dob_parts(dob):
                results.append((True, uid))

    if not results:
        return None
    results.sort(key=lambda r: (not r[0], r[1]))
    return results[0][1]


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--watchlist', required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--customers', required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--out', required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    with open(args.watchlist, encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        wl = json.load(fh)
    eng = Engine(wl)

    with open(args.customers, encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as fh:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(fh))

    with open(args.out, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(['customer_id', 'decision', 'matched_uid'])
        for row in rows:
            uid = screen_customer(row, eng)
            if uid:
                w.writerow([row.get('customer_id', ''), 'MATCH', uid])
            else:
                w.writerow([row.get('customer_id', ''), 'NO_MATCH', ''])
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Score decisions against dev labels, with per-class breakdown."""
import csv, sys, collections

dec_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/app/dev/decisions_dev.csv'
lab_path = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else '/app/dev/labels_dev.csv'
verbose = '-v' in sys.argv

dec = {r['customer_id']: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(dec_path))}
lab = list(csv.DictReader(open(lab_path)))
cust = {r['customer_id']: r for r in csv.DictReader(open('/app/dev/customers_dev.csv'))}

tp = fp = fn = 0
uid_ok = 0
byclass = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])  # [n, bad]
errors = collections.defaultdict(list)

for l in lab:
    cid = l['customer_id']
    d = dec.get(cid)
    got = d['decision'] if d else 'NO_MATCH'
    got_uid = (d['matched_uid'] if d else '') or ''
    exp = l['expected_decision']
    exp_uid = l['expected_uid'] or ''
    cls = l['class']
    byclass[cls][0] += 1
    if exp == 'MATCH':
        if got == 'MATCH':
            tp += 1
            if got_uid == exp_uid:
                uid_ok += 1
            else:
                byclass[cls][1] += 1
                errors[cls].append((cid, 'WRONGUID', got_uid, exp_uid))
        else:
            fn += 1
            byclass[cls][1] += 1
            errors[cls].append((cid, 'MISS', got_uid, exp_uid))
    else:
        if got == 'MATCH':
            fp += 1
            byclass[cls][1] += 1
            errors[cls].append((cid, 'FP', got_uid, exp_uid))

recall = tp / max(1, tp + fn)
prec = tp / max(1, tp + fp)
print('TP %d FP %d FN %d  recall %.4f  precision %.4f  uid_acc %.4f' % (
    tp, fp, fn, recall, prec, uid_ok / max(1, tp)))
print()
for cls in sorted(byclass):
    n, bad = byclass[cls]
    kind = 'recall' if cls.startswith('T') else 'fp-rate'
    print('%-28s n=%4d bad=%3d  %s=%.4f' % (cls, n, bad, kind, (n - bad) / n if kind == 'recall' else bad / n))

if verbose:
    print()
    for cls in sorted(errors):
        print('===', cls)
        for cid, kind, got, exp in errors[cls][:40]:
            c = cust.get(cid, {})
            print('  %s %-8s got=%-10s exp=%-10s  %r | %s | %s' % (
                cid, kind, got, exp, c.get('full_name'), c.get('dob'), c.get('type')))

       ('ts', 'c'), ('y', 'j'), ('ya', 'ja'), ('yu', 'ju')]
GER = [('kh', 'ch'), ('sh', 'sch'), ('zh', 'sch'), ('ch', 'tsch'), ('v', 'w'),
       ('ts', 'z'), ('y', 'i'), ('j', 'dsch')]
FRA = [('kh', 'kh'), ('sh', 'ch'), ('zh', 'j'), ('ch', 'tch'), ('ou', 'ou'),
       ('u', 'ou'), ('v', 'v'), ('ts', 'ts')]
DOUBLE = [('m', 'mm'), ('l', 'll'), ('s', 'ss'), ('n', 'nn')]
VOW = [('i', 'ee'), ('u', 'ou'), ('a', 'e'), ('o', 'ou')]


def apply_rules(s, rules, start_rules=()):
    out = s
    for pat, rep in start_rules:
        out = re.sub(pat, rep, out, flags=re.I)
    for pat, rep in rules:
        out = re.sub(re.escape(pat), rep, out, flags=re.I)
    return out


def trailing_e(s):
    return re.sub(r'\b([A-Za-z]{3,}[bcdfgklmnprstvz])\b', r'\1e', s)


def swap_order(s):
    t = s.replace(',', ' ').split()
    if len(t) < 2:
        return s
    return t[-1] + ', ' + ' '.join(t[:-1])


def add_initial(s):
    t = s.split()
    if len(t) < 2:
        return s
    return t[0] + ' ' + 'M.' + ' ' + ' '.join(t[1:])

    'indo': lambda s: apply_rules(s, INDO, INDO_START),
    'pol': lambda s: apply_rules(s, POL),
    'sci': lambda s: apply_rules(s, SCI),
    'ger': lambda s: apply_rules(s, GER),
    'fra': lambda s: apply_rules(s, FRA),
    'dbl': lambda s: apply_rules(s, DOUBLE),
    'vow': lambda s: apply_rules(s, VOW),
    'traile': trailing_e,
    'swap': swap_order,
    'init': add_initial,
    'turk+dbl': lambda s: apply_rules(apply_rules(s, TURK, TURK_END), DOUBLE),
    'indo+vow': lambda s: apply_rules(apply_rules(s, INDO, INDO_START), VOW),
    'pol+traile': lambda s: trailing_e(apply_rules(s, POL)),

}

input.command:
cat > /app/covtest.py <<'EOF'
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Which customer name tokens match no watchlist token at all?"""
import csv, json, sys, collections
import screen

wl = json.load(open('/app/watchlist.json'))
wtoks = set()
for e in wl:
    names = [e['primary_name']] + ([e['script_name']] if e.get('script_name') else [])
    names += [a['name'] for a in e['aliases']]
    for n in names:
        for t in screen.parse_name(n).core:
            wtoks.add(t)
index = collections.defaultdict(set)
for t in wtoks:
    for k in t.sk:
        index[k].add(t)

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/app/customers.csv'
miss = collections.Counter()
hit = collections.Counter()
for r in csv.DictReader(open(path)):
    if (r['type'] or 'individual') != 'individual':
        continue
    for t in screen.parse_name(r['full_name']).core:
        cands = set()
        for k in t.sk:
            cands |= index.get(k, set())
        ok = any(screen.tok_match(t, c) for c in cands)
        (hit if ok else miss)[t.raw] += 1
print('distinct hit %d  distinct miss %d  (token instances miss %d / %d)' % (
    len(hit), len(miss), sum(miss.values()), sum(miss.values()) + sum(hit.values())))
for tok, c in miss.most_common(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 60):
    print('  %-28s %d' % (tok, c))
EOF
cd /app && python3 covtest.py customers.csv 70

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""False-positive fuzz: recombine given/family names that belong to no entry,
re-spell them, and check the engine rejects them."""
import json, random, re, sys, collections
import screen
from fuzz import transform, CONVENTIONS

wl = json.load(open('/app/watchlist.json'))
eng = screen.Engine(wl)
W = {e['uid']: e for e in wl}

people = []
for e in wl:
    if e['type'] != 'individual':
        continue
    n = e['primary_name']
    if screen.ARABIC_RE.search(n) or screen.CYRILLIC_RE.search(n):
        alt = [a['name'] for a in e['aliases'] if a['strength'] == 'strong'
               and not screen.ARABIC_RE.search(a['name'])
               and not screen.CYRILLIC_RE.search(a['name'])]
        if not alt:
            continue
        n = alt[0]
    toks = screen.split_tokens(n)
    core = screen.parse_name(n).core
    if len(core) != 2:
        continue
    # keep the surface strings
    ts = [t for t in re.split(r'[\s,]+', n) if t]
    people.append((e['uid'], ts))


def canon_match(name):
    p = screen.parse_name(name)
    out = []
    for idx in eng.candidates(p):
        en = eng.person_names[idx]
        if eng.entries[en.uid].get('type', 'individual') != 'individual':
            continue
        if screen.names_match(p, en.parsed):
            out.append(en.uid)
    return out


rnd = random.Random(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 3)
N = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 3000
fp = tot = 0
examples = []
for _ in range(N):
    a, b = rnd.sample(people, 2)
    if rnd.random() < 0.5:
        name = a[1][0] + ' ' + b[1][-1]        # given of A + family of B
    else:
        name = b[1][0] + ' ' + a[1][-1]
    if canon_match(name):
        continue                                # legitimately on the list
    v = transform(name, rnd)
    tot += 1
    row = {'customer_id': 'X', 'full_name': v, 'dob': '', 'nationality': '',
           'id_type': '', 'id_number': '', 'type': 'individual'}
    got = screen.screen_customer(row, eng)
    if got is not None:
        fp += 1
        if len(examples) < 30:
            g = W[got]
            examples.append((v, name, got, g['primary_name'],
                             g.get('script_name')))
print('decoy false-positive rate %.4f  (%d / %d)' % (fp / max(1, tot), fp, tot))
for v, name, got, pn, sn in examples:
    print('   %-38r <- %-32r %s %-34r %s' % (v, name, got, pn, sn or ''))

content.text:
Both deliverables are in place.

## What I built

**`/app/screen.py`** — stdlib-only engine, 1.4 s for the 3,045-row batch (5.6 s for 12 k rows, 67 MB peak), deterministic across hash seeds.

The core idea is that each name token reduces to a **set** of abstract phoneme strings, not one code. Ambiguous graphemes branch: `ch` → /tʃ, ʃ, x, k/, `c` → /k, ts, tʃ, dʒ/ (Turkish *Cemal*), `j` → /dʒ, ʒ/ (French *Jukoff*) or a Slavic glide, `s` → /ʃ/ (Turkish *ş*, scientific *š* with the diacritic dropped), `cz/sz/w` for Polish, `oe/sj/dj` for Indonesian. Vowels collapse to three classes with their own digraph table. Two tokens correspond when their key sets intersect, so any two conventions that can spell the same sound meet somewhere in the middle.

Arabic script writes no short vowels, so Arabic tokens yield consonant+long-vowel keys and Latin tokens yield a second "skeleton" set where single written vowels may drop. Latin-vs-Latin never uses skeletons — that's what keeps *Hasan* apart from *Hussein*. An entry's original-script name is consulted only for a script customer or when the entry has no Latin spelling at all.

Above that sit name parsing (comma/family-first order, chained particles, sun-letter assimilation, `bin/ibn` nasab, `Abd al-` compounds, patronymics, compound surnames, initials), a curated nickname table, feminine Slavic surname stems, entity legal-form stripping, vessel prefixes, and the DOB/identifier/tie-break rules.

**`/app/decisions.csv`** — 3,045 rows, 997 MATCH / 2,048 NO_MATCH.

## How I validated it

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Dev sample, all 23 classes | recall 1.000, precision 1.000, uid 1.000 |
| Every strong alias vs its own entry | 0 / 683 failures |
| Turkish, Indonesian, scientific-no-diacritics, Polish, German, French re-spellings of every watchlist name | 4,444 checks, **0** failures |
| Stacked-convention respelling fuzz (4 seeds) | 97.6 – 98.7 % recall |
| Recombined-decoy fuzz (3 seeds) | 0.14 – 0.29 % false positives |
| 500 sampled batch NO_MATCHes vs a looser consonant-only matcher | 4 near-hits, all correct rejections |

Two known limits I chose to accept: *Yasin* (Arabic) and *Yashin* (Russian) collide because Turkish/scientific `s`→/ʃ/ is required for *Şahin* and *Sevcenko*; and a decorative trailing `-e` makes *Qasime* reachable from *Ghasemi*, which is inherent to the generator's own trailing-e rule. Both are single name pairs, far inside the FP budget.
